bounds.description: Slider min/max bounds. Optional; the widget has sensible Canadian defaults.

amortization_years.description: Defaults to 25. Only first-time buyers and new builds may use 30 on an insured mortgage.

down_payment_cad.description: What the customer has saved, in CAD.

first_time_buyer.description: Unlocks the FHSA and Home Buyers Plan booster and the land transfer tax rebate.

gross_annual_income_cad.description: Household income before tax, including a co-buyer.

interest_rate_pct.description: Contract rate from mortgage_rate_board. The widget stress-tests it internally.

monthly_debt_obligations_cad.description: Cards, loans, leases, child support. Not rent.

property_type.description: Detached | Semi-detached | Townhouse | Condo | Duplex. Condos carry fees that count toward debt service.

province.description: Two-letter code, e.g. ON. Drives land transfer tax and the first-time buyer rebate.

defaults.description: Starting values. All CAD. Prefill anything already known about the customer.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'mortgage_affordability'

submit_cta_label.description: Primary button label, e.g. 'Continue with this budget'.

submit_cta_value.description: Sent back to the agent on tap. The widget appends the current inputs and the computed max price as JSON.

subtitle.description: Widget sub-header, plain and calm. Must not promise a pre-approval.

title.description: Widget header, e.g. 'What could you afford?'.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'
